svg.desc: OpenBridge Control Valve (OpenBridge obc-analog-valve, Apache-2.0). Bindable properties: _pn_position (default 0): Valve position % _pb_open (default false): Open feedback _pb_vertical (default false): Vertical orientation _pb_alarm (default false): Alarm active (red alert frame) _pb_auto (default false): Auto mode badge _ps_tag (default ''): Numeric equipment ID shown as #NNNN (empty = hidden)
